title: PRD-18 synthetic risk input syntax

projectName.description: required; 1–200 NFC characters. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: PROJECT_NAME_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

projectTypeCode.description: required; carrier-mapped project category <= 80. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: PROJECT_TYPE_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

siteRefs.description: required; 1–100 authorized locations. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PROJECT_SITE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

insuredValue.description: required; positive; value components separate. Sensitivity: financial. Error: PROJECT_VALUE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

projectStart.description: required; explicit site-local date. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: PROJECT_PERIOD_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

projectEnd.description: required; not before start. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: PROJECT_PERIOD_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

contractorPartyRefs.description: required; 1–100 role-linked participants. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: CONTRACTOR_ROLE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

technicalDossierRef.description: required for underwriting; versioned design/scope/evidence bundle. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: TECHNICAL_DOSSIER_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
